messages:
Alex R.: Heads up — I'm stuck in the airport security line, going to miss my full handoff window at 02:00UTC. I'm still primary for ~30m but I need an immediate swap if there's any paging. If anyone can take primary sooner, please say so.

rotation-bot: :gear: pending-swap request created: from Alex R. -> Mira S. effective in 30m (scheduled at 1769511600). Use `/rotation cancel` to abort.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: service-embeds-high-error at 1769510005
- Severity: P3->P2 (escalating)
- Symptom: 500 errors on embeddings ingestion, 20% error rate over 5m
- Impact: some search/video-recommendation batches dropping embeddings -> visible in recent deploy dashboards
- Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-2345

Sam K.: I'm online and can be secondary right now. @Mira S. can you take primary if needed? I'm on laptop for 20m. :+1:

Mira S.: I can take primary immediately if Alex wants me to force the swap now. I can also ack the page and start triage. Alex — do you want me to assume primary now?

Alex R.: Yes please force it. I'm still queuing at security, won't get network for a bit. Doing a manual swap now and copying the handoff checklist.

Alex R.: ```
Handoff checklist (quick):
1) Announce primary change in #eng-oncall
2) Run `deploy check` to verify recent model rollouts
3) Check /incidents open for related pages
4) If page active, ack and assign temporary runbook owner
5) Update oncall-note with ETA and who is secondary
```

rotation-bot: :white_check_mark: swap-executed at 1769510105 — Primary: Mira S., Secondary: Sam K. (swap initiated by Alex R.)

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PAGE ACK by Mira S. at 1769510110
- Triage note: error spikes correlate with recent quantized-model v3.1 rollout at 1769508800. Observed memory churn on GPU hosts and KV-cache evictions.

Mira S.: Ack and triage notes: scaling up embeddings pool by +2 nodes (hotfix), and rolling traffic to model v2.3 as safe fallback per runbook. Running `reroute embeddings -> fallback-v2.3` now. If rollback stops errors, we'll keep v2.3 and open regression ticket.

Sam K.: Standing by as secondary. I'll monitor traces and heatmaps, and prepare to run `traffic-cut --service embeddings --percent 20` if Mira asks. Also flagged infra for extra nvme cleanup on the affected nodes.

Alex R.: Thanks team. Two quick operational notes while I'm offline: 1) the rotation infra blocked auto-escalation during the scheduled pending-swap, which caused the initial page to stay un-escalated for ~3m — filing follow-up with rotation infra: https://redwood.internal/tickets/ROT-987 (please add any logs). 2) Runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff (contains the rollback commands Mira used).

Mira S.: Post-mitigation update (later): scaling + rollback stopped errors within 4m, error rate back to baseline. Keeping primary for remainder of window. Will open postmortem if regression confirmed.

Sam K.: Confirming monitoring graphs are green. If Mira wants to hand back before scheduled end, I'll be ready.

rotation-bot: :calendar: note: manual swap recorded; oncall calendar updated.

Alex R.: Appreciate it — I'll follow up with the travel/rotation infra notes once I'm back at my laptop. :airplane:
